problem.title: Count Even Numbers
problem.excerpt: Given N integers, print how many are even.

human.code:
n=int(input())
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
c=0
for x in a:
    if x%2==0:c+=1
print(c)

N = int(input())
A = list(map(int,input().split()))
print(len([i for i in A if i%2==0]))

ai.code:
n = int(input())
values = list(map(int, input().split()))
count = 0
for value in values:
    if value % 2 == 0:
        count += 1
print(count)
